meta.source: NetSuite REST API Browser — Record API
meta.propertyShape: {name, type, ref?, title?, required?, enum?}  (type='ref' -> see 'ref' key into definitions; enum capped at 60 values)
notes: definitions holds ALL schemas: 151 top-level records + sub-resource collections/elements + shared refs (nsLink, nsResource, etc.).
records lists the 151 top-level REST record types (from the browser nav).
Inline sub-objects are FLATTENED into the parent's property list (a property of type 'object' is followed by its inner properties); typed sub-resources use 'ref'.
This is a 2024.2 snapshot. For exact/current per-account fields, use the metadata-catalog: /services/rest/record/v1/metadata-catalog/{recordType}.
REST field names (camelCase) differ from SuiteScript internal IDs in records.json — see rest-record-api.md mapping.
